judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Folksy, slightly clumsy merchant talk ('Actually, business has fallen off quite a bit', 'You got yourself quite a bargain, lad!', 'my two buildings') and a blunt gold price with a yes/no outcome match Nox's side-deal style. The repeated 'stay' in the farewell is the kind of unpolished line Westwood shipped.
